fact: Local taxes, previously handled manually with communes never having digitalised their financial services, have since January 2025 been merged into a single tax (IGS) collected online by the tax administration, while communal fees such as market and parking remain collected directly and undigitised.
title: Recouvrement des impôts locaux : le coup de pouce salutaire de l'administration fiscale
publisher: Actu Cameroun (editorial by Eric Boniface Thouakeu)
